name: Perfect Dark
subtitle: Perfect Dark for iPhone & Vision Pro
localizedDescription: Rare's N64 shooter running natively on iPhone and Apple Vision Pro — the Perfect Dark decompilation through Dab's Mod, rendering on Metal. Dab's Mod adds jump, a combat roll, melee combos, a third-person camera, up to 80 simulants in the Combat Simulator and bodies that stay where they fell, plus XBLA support: drop in your own copy of the 2010 Xbox 360 release and the game draws 4J Studios' high-resolution art instead of the N64 art. On Apple Vision Pro there is a world-locked stereoscopic 3D mode with foveated rendering. Ships with no game content — you supply your own Perfect Dark (USA) Rev 1 ROM, and your own Xbox 360 copy if you want the XBLA art.
